documented_probe: Covering task for C-446b41c3 (compute the sqrt wasserstein distance from the transport cost). Distinct from iris-terrace: standalone freight-desk module+CLI with a single rooted-distance deliverable and root-clamp/negative-dot probes, instead of one section of a multi-part numerics fitting task.
notes: Single module + CLI: dot product of plan and cost, clamp to non-negative, square root, JSON out. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (metric vs squared-cost distinction), debugging_ambiguity (the classic unrooted bug is the trap), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (zero plan, negative dot, rectangular, larger matrices), quantitative_correctness (exact float distances recomputed independently).
